business_problem: MNP needed a better way to support client-facing generative AI advisory and contextual financial analysis because traditional analytics platforms could not support the LLM-powered services and data preparation needed for faster client advisory deployments.
solution_summary: MNP uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support client-facing generative AI advisory and contextual financial analysis. The implementation replaced a legacy state where traditional analytics platforms could not support the LLM-powered services and data preparation needed for faster client advisory deployments. Client data and financial services knowledge move through production data pipelines and land in shared lakehouse datasets, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Model Serving, Agent Bricks, and AI Search operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver GenAI advisory insights and client decision support. MNP improved client-facing generative AI advisory and contextual financial analysis with measurable results including <6 weeks, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
